name: Rhodes
author: Tim Kahn (tim.kahn, freesound); gap notes: Frank Wen (FluidR3 GM) / packaged for DAW
source: https://freesound.org/people/tim.kahn/packs/3957/ (C_S Fender Rhodes Mark II); MIDI 65-84 from FluidR3_GM.sf2 "Rhodes EP" (http://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/f/fluid-soundfont/)

desc: Fender Rhodes Mark II stage electric piano (tine EP), 3 velocity layers: soft = round and mellow, medium = classic bell-like tine, hard = barky/overdriven. Range E1-E7 (MIDI 28-100), best C2-C6. Neo-soul, R&B, jazz, lo-fi hip-hop, gospel and funk chords (7ths/9ths), soft ballads; natural decay. | Playable MIDI 28-100 (E1-E7), 3 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: pedal=1 lets notes ring until the next chord (sustain pedal, re-pedals on each new note); human 0-1 adds timing/level life; velcurve <1.6 = soft notes louder; bright = velocity opens tone; keytrack = high notes brighter.
